cand.title: Rive Jazzy 2027
cand.excerpt: Verified organized demand is valuable, but committed venue and absent lodging data reduce current accessibility.

verifyPrev.futureEditionText: Official organizer announcement: “See you in Summer 2027 (01.07-08.08)”. The festival network identifies the 34th edition as 1 July–8 August 2027 in Quartier de Rive, Nyon. These are activity-window dates, not article dates, and fall within the requested horizon. quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified named organizer contacts: Thomas Greter, Direction Opérationnelle; Thomas Winteler, Direction Artistique. Winteler has the strongest edition-specific linkage: the festival-network listing announcing the 2027 edition publishes +41 76 374 81 63, identical to his official team-page number. Greter is the current operational lead on the organizer website; a separate 2027 appointment is not published. Neither is verified as controlling hotel contracts.
findings.futureEdition: 34th edition published for 1 July–8 August 2027. These are festival-window dates, not a confirmed daily concert schedule.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: investigate artist/crew lodging or a small organizer allocation only if transport between Founex and Nyon is acceptable. The outdoor Nyon festival does not establish a requirement for hotel meeting space or a 20–120-room block.
findings.venueCommitments: Published location: Quartier de Rive, Nyon. This is an outdoor festival location, not evidence of an open hotel venue requirement or signed venue contracts.
findings.accommodationSourcing: No hotel procurement process, incumbent accommodation supplier, room block or open sourcing mandate established by the reviewed sources.
findings.organizationStructure: The official 2026 programme places the festival within the activities of the Association pour l’Animation du Quartier de Rive and names its organizing committee. Do not treat the festival venue or tourism office as the accommodation buyer.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Thomas Greter first through the official general-contact form or his published business number; copy or reference Thomas Winteler for artist-related requirements. Ask who arranges and pays for visiting artists’ and crew accommodation for 1 July–8 August 2027, whether suppliers are already appointed, nightly room needs, and transfer requirements. Do not submit an assumed room block or claim an RFP exists.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 edition is announced and named organizer approach routes are public. Hotel sourcing accessibility remains unconfirmed.

supportingSources.claim: Official organizer team identifies Thomas Greter as operational director and Thomas Winteler as artistic director, with public business telephone numbers.
2027 edition dates, Nyon location and festival contact number matching Thomas Winteler’s official team entry.
supportingSources.factVsInference: fact; identity linkage based on identical published number

supportingSources.claim: Regional tourism corroborates 34th edition, 1 July–8 August 2027, Rue de Rive in Nyon.
Official general-contact route for organizer enquiries and proposals.
2026 programme identifies the association context and committee; historical context, not proof of 2027 hotel purchasing authority.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Confirm 2027 accommodation ownership and supplier status directly with Thomas Greter or Thomas Winteler before upgrading sales qualification.
remainingUncertainties: Who controls and pays for 2027 artist/crew accommodation, and whether any procurement remains open.
Whether current operational director Thomas Greter has an explicitly assigned 2027 accommodation remit.
Nightly room requirements, incumbent hotels, budget and transfers between Nyon and Founex are unverified.
